rationale.conceptual: The method uses a known technique (MD with EAM) but requires non-trivial implementation: building HCP cubic hexagon models of varying size, proper equilibration, uniaxial tension with appropriate strain rate, and extraction of size-dependent elastic constants and a self-balancing stress profile. It is an established but multi-part protocol that needs careful attention to simulation details.
rationale.execution: The pipeline has multiple stages (model generation for several sizes, running separate MD relaxations and tension tests, post-processing stress-strain data, and computing a stress profile) with dependencies, but it can be orchestrated with straightforward scripting and standard tools (LAMMPS, Python). There is one tricky step (constructing the HCP nanowire geometry) but overall complexity is moderate.
